title: TSP1 - Applied Brain Research
summary: The TSP1 is a time-series neural network accelerator designed for ultra-low power edge AI applications. It features ABR's patented state-space model processing technology and the Legendre Memory Unit (LMU). The chip supports up to 20 million parameters, operates at <35mW for text-to-speech tasks, and includes interfaces like SPI, I2C, and GPIO for sensor integration. Package options include a 42-pin WLCSP and 44-pin QFN.
tldr: The TSP1 is an ultra-low power time-series neural network accelerator chip designed by Applied Brain Research for edge AI applications such as automatic speech recognition and biosignal classification.
